page: Vultr vbm-256c-2048gb-8-mi300x-gpu is a bare metal server configured with dual AMD EPYC 9534 processors. It features 128 physical cores and 256 vCPUs operating at a base frequency of 2.45 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. The system is equipped with 2048.0 GB of system memory, providing an allocation of 8.0 GB of RAM per CPU core to support high-throughput data processing.

This server integrates eight AMD CDNA3 MI300X graphics processing units, delivering a combined total of 1536 GB of high-bandwidth VRAM with 192 GiB per GPU. For local storage, the configuration includes 28608 GB of NVMe SSD capacity, offering high-capacity, low-latency local data access. A single complimentary public IPv4 address is included.

Given the high density of AMD MI300X accelerators and massive system memory, this bare metal instance is designed for large-scale artificial intelligence workloads, including large language model training, high-performance computing simulations, and parallelized data science pipelines. The bare metal architecture eliminates virtualization overhead, maximizing resource utilization and cost efficiency for compute-intensive enterprise workloads.
